content.text:
Confirmed: at line 537, during polling (`compareRemoteRevisionWithLocal`), `BuildChooserContextImpl` is constructed with `build = null`. Any `BuildChooser` calling `context.getBuild().getEnvironment()` during a poll will NPE. That exact call was introduced into `InverseBuildChooser.java` by commit `9ec710b`, and it was never touched again until the fix commit `88ddc23`. Commit `d162f31` added the proper `getEnvironment()` method to the `BuildChooserContext` interface and fixed the equivalent line in `DefaultBuildChooser.java`, but missed updating `InverseBuildChooser.java`, leaving the original NPE-prone line from `9ec710b` in place.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 9ec710b2c1122df901da5c33c5b1c6df47eb3e36

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the file history of `InverseBuildChooser.java` and the `BuildChooserContext` interface with `git log -p`. The fix commit (`88ddc23`) replaces `context.getBuild().getEnvironment()` with `context.getEnvironment()`. I located the commit that first introduced the `context.getBuild().getEnvironment()` line (`9ec710b`, 2013-12-04) and the commit that introduced the `BuildChooserContext.getEnvironment()` method as the "correct" alternative (`d162f31`, 2014-02-17).

**(2) Specific change:** Commit `9ec710b` added branch-spec environment-variable expansion support. As part of this, it added `EnvVars env = context.getBuild().getEnvironment();` to both `DefaultBuildChooser.java` and `InverseBuildChooser.java`. This is unsafe because `context.getBuild()` can be `null` — `GitSCM.compareRemoteRevisionWithLocal` (the polling path) constructs its `BuildChooserContextImpl` with `build = null` (see `GitSCM.java:537`). Calling `.getEnvironment()` on that `null` build throws a `NullPointerException` whenever `InverseBuildChooser` is used for SCM polling.

Later, `d162f31` recognized this defect and added a dedicated `getEnvironment()` method directly on `BuildChooserContext` (backed by an `EnvVars` field that is populated independently of the `AbstractBuild`, so it's safe to use during polling). It updated `DefaultBuildChooser.java` to use `context.getEnvironment()` instead of the unsafe `context.getBuild().getEnvironment()`, but did not touch `InverseBuildChooser.java`, which still contained the original unsafe line from `9ec710b`. Commit `88ddc23` simply applies the same fix to `InverseBuildChooser.java` that `d162f31` had already applied to `DefaultBuildChooser.java`.

**(3) Evidence:** 
- `git show 9ec710b` shows the line `EnvVars env = context.getBuild().getEnvironment();` being added to `InverseBuildChooser.java` (and identically to `DefaultBuildChooser.java`).
- `git show d162f31` shows the parallel, intentional fix applied only to `DefaultBuildChooser.java` (`context.getEnvironment()`), plus the new `getEnvironment()` method added to `BuildChooserContext`/`BuildChooserContextImpl`. `d162f31`'s diff does not touch `InverseBuildChooser.java` at all.
- `GitSCM.java:537` confirms `build` is passed as `null` in the polling code path, which is the exact scenario that would trigger the NPE the fix commit resolves.

I'm fairly confident `9ec710b` is the bug-introducing commit, since it is the sole commit that wrote the faulty line into `InverseBuildChooser.java`, and that line was never modified again before the fix. The main uncertainty is whether one considers `d162f31` a contributing "miss" (it fixed the identical bug in a sibling class but overlooked `InverseBuildChooser.java`) — but it introduced no new faulty code itself, so I attribute the bug solely to `9ec710b`.
